qa.name: Supraspinatus
qa.insertion: Superior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Initiates abduction of the arm (first 15 degrees), assists deltoid in full abduction
qa.clinical_note: Most commonly torn rotator cuff muscle — tested by the empty-can (Jobe) test

qa.name: Infraspinatus
qa.insertion: Middle facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Lateral (external) rotation of the arm; stabilizes glenohumeral joint
qa.clinical_note: Tested by external rotation against resistance with elbow at 90 degrees

qa.name: Teres Minor
qa.origin: Lateral border of the scapula (upper two-thirds)
qa.insertion: Inferior facet of the greater tubercle of the humerus
qa.function: Lateral (external) rotation of the arm; adduction of the arm
qa.clinical_note: Only rotator cuff muscle innervated by the axillary nerve — not the suprascapular nerve

qa.name: Subscapularis
qa.origin: Subscapular fossa of the scapula (anterior surface)
qa.function: Medial (internal) rotation of the arm; adduction of the arm
qa.clinical_note: Only anterior rotator cuff muscle — tested by the lift-off (Gerber) test and belly-press test
